data.text: Anders (user) explicitly asks for the BOARD microphone as the voice input instead of the Mac. Anders' agent owns this firmware change on branch anders/board-mic: physical move AHT20 port 10 → 7, microphone module on [10,11], and office_station gets mic_start/mic_stop actions that stream 16 kHz PCM (base64 mic_pcm events). Everything else in Leo's verified map is unchanged. Don't flash the board in parallel.
